english.note: Use 怪事 for an unusual or puzzling event when its strangeness matters more than its scientific or neutral status.

examples.english: The elevator opened by itself last night; it was really a strange phenomenon.
examples.traditional: 尋晚部電梯自己開咗門，真係怪事。
